prompt_en: Generate an entirely new photorealistic cinematic wuxia action photograph on a wind-struck canal-market footbridge at lantern-lit dusk, using Image 1 solely as an appearance reference for the adult intervener. One adult intervener one aggressor and one threatened traveler or civilian remain separately readable as complete full-body figures spaced across the bridge planks. The aggressor action and body line visibly target the threatened traveler or civilian as a polearm thrust aligns directly with the medicine courier's torso. The adult intervener physically enters the same threat line between aggressor and threatened person with her planted body centered across the weapon path, and her sheathed saber meets the polearm shaft at a visible blocking contact. The threat is visibly blocked redirected or delayed long enough to create an escape opening as the courier pivots toward unobstructed bridge stairs descending directly to a tied boat. The protective relation is proven by event geometry and consequence rather than costume face title reputation presumed virtue or an unrelated trio; crossed weapon contact, the intervening stance, and the courier's active retreat make the causal relation unmistakable. Use a 40 mm diagonal view with crisp faces, hands, weapon contact, stairs, and boat. Warm lantern light crosses blue canal water; a torn banner and dropped satchel hold the market context while restrained blur preserves contact.
